;;;; game-2048.lisp -- the game 2048 as a text game.

(in-package :game-2048)

(defconstant +size+ 4
  "Number of rows and of columns of a board.")

(defun make-empty-board ()
  "A fresh, empty 4x4 board."
  (make-array (list +size+ +size+) :initial-element 0))

(defun slide-row (row)
  "Slide ROW toward its first element, merging tiles.
Returns a fresh list of the same length and the points gained."
  (let ((tiles (remove 0 row))
        (merged '())
        (points 0))
    (loop while tiles
          do (let ((a (pop tiles)))
               (if (and tiles (= a (first tiles)))
                   (let ((sum (+ a (pop tiles))))
                     (push sum merged)
                     (incf points sum))
                   (push a merged))))
    (setf merged (nreverse merged))
    (values (append merged
                    (make-list (- (length row) (length merged))
                               :initial-element 0))
            points)))

(defun line-positions (direction index)
  "The cells of line INDEX (a row for :left/:right, a column for :up/:down)
as (row . column) pairs, ordered from the side the move goes toward."
  (let ((ordered (loop for k below +size+ collect k)))
    (ecase direction
      (:left (mapcar (lambda (k) (cons index k)) ordered))
      (:right (mapcar (lambda (k) (cons index k)) (reverse ordered)))
      (:up (mapcar (lambda (k) (cons k index)) ordered))
      (:down (mapcar (lambda (k) (cons k index)) (reverse ordered))))))

(defun move (board direction)
  "Slide every line of BOARD toward DIRECTION (:left :right :up :down).
Returns a fresh board, the points gained, and true if any cell changed."
  (let ((new (make-empty-board))
        (points 0)
        (changed nil))
    (dotimes (index +size+)
      (let* ((positions (line-positions direction index))
             (old (mapcar (lambda (p) (aref board (car p) (cdr p))) positions)))
        (multiple-value-bind (slid gained) (slide-row old)
          (incf points gained)
          (unless (equal old slid)
            (setf changed t))
          (loop for p in positions
                for v in slid
                do (setf (aref new (car p) (cdr p)) v)))))
    (values new points changed)))

(defun spawn-tile (board random-state)
  "A fresh copy of BOARD with one new tile (2 with 90%, 4 with 10%)
in a random empty cell."
  (let ((empties '()))
    (dotimes (r +size+)

(defpackage #:game-2048-tests
  (:use #:common-lisp #:game-2048 #:util.test))

(in-package #:game-2048-tests)

(defun make-board (rows)
  "Build a board from a list of four lists of four integers."
  (let ((b (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (loop for row in rows
          for r from 0
          do (loop for v in row
                   for c from 0
                   do (setf (aref b r c) v)))
    b))

(defun board-rows (board)
  "The rows of BOARD as a list of lists."
  (loop for r below 4
        collect (loop for c below 4 collect (aref board r c))))

(defun slide-result (row)
  (multiple-value-list (slide-row row)))

(defun move-result (board direction)
  (multiple-value-bind (new points changed) (move board direction)
    (list (board-rows new) points changed)))

(defun run-play (input-string &optional (seed (make-random-state nil)))
  "Run PLAY on INPUT-STRING with a copy of SEED; return the output as a string."
  (let ((out (make-string-output-stream)))
    (play :input (make-string-input-stream input-string)
          :output out
          :random-state (make-random-state seed))
    (get-output-stream-string out)))

(test '((4 4 0 0) 8) (slide-result (list 2 2 2 2)))
(test '((4 2 0 0) 4) (slide-result (list 2 2 2 0)))
(test '((4 0 0 0) 4) (slide-result (list 0 2 0 2)))
(test '((2 4 8 16) 0) (slide-result (list 2 4 8 16)))
(test '((4 4 0 0) 4) (slide-result (list 2 2 4 0)))

      (let ((row (list 2 2 0 0)))

(test t

             (result (slide-row row)))
        (and (equal result '(2 4 8 16)) (not (eq result row)))))
